item.title: Quple 0.1.2
item.description:
iPhone: moving a call to the Mac no longer hangs it up

The iPhone left the room with close() and then end(..., false). close()
makes the SDK fire onReadyToClose, whose end() ran first and hung up:
the other side's app saw "hung up" and ended its call, leaving the Mac
alone in the room (nginx, 2026-11-17 15:08:59: the iPhone's POST /hangup
as it handed over). Now end() comes first, so onReadyToClose's end()
does nothing. The watchdog's and CallKit's ends get the same order,
which also keeps the watchdog's reason as the notice.
